explanation: Instantiates the query scratch interface from uniform reservations. The mask interval, work interval, and arithmetic word bound are supplied separately for the actual selected level catalog.
theorem_title: The query reservation supplies level scratch
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.query_scratch {lim : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Limits} {report h J NB NC g s i j k maskBase work : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ _root_.ThreeSum.LightSwitchDepth.depth J)
    (hmasks : maskBase+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.queryMaskSpan h J ≤ work)
    (hspace : work+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.queryWorkSpan h J ≤ lim.space)
    (hword : (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.queryWord h J g : ℤ) ≤ lim.word) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.ReportingHostLevelData.Scratch lim h J k
      (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankAccess.levelCatalog report h J NB NC g s i j k)
      (_root_.ThreeSum.BandRawA.finiteBandPositions NB g i).card
      (_root_.ThreeSum.BandRawA.finiteBandPositions NC g j).card maskBase work := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $\ell$ be Light limits and $h,J,k$ local parameters with $k$ at most the terminal depth. Choose any reporting bank, occurrence, and independent band indices. If the query-mask buffer ends before the work pointer, the reserved work interval ends within $\ell$'s space, and the stated query-word bound fits in $\ell$'s word limit, then the selected level catalog satisfies its complete scratch contract for the two actual finite band sizes.

Instantiates the query scratch interface from uniform reservations. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
